name: sol_integrations_uniswap_10
description: Hard-coded Uniswap V3 fee tier parameter in swap function
question: The source file in `source` contains a function that initiates a Uniswap V3 swap (e.g. via exactInput/exactOutput or a swap router call) where the pool fee tier parameter is hard-coded as a fixed constant instead of being passed in as a caller-supplied or configurable parameter, potentially routing swaps to a low-liquidity or wrong fee-tier pool and causing worse pricing or execution failure; this excludes functions that accept the fee tier as an input parameter or read it from configurable, admin-set storage.
criteria: A swap function calls the Uniswap V3 router's exactInputSingle/exactOutputSingle with the fee field set to a literal constant like 3000 or 500
A function builds a Uniswap V3 path bytes via abi.encodePacked using a hard-coded fee constant instead of a parameter
An internal helper that performs a Uniswap V3 swap defines fee as a constant or immutable set once at deployment with no per-call override
